correctness.rationale: All maximal abelian groups and their central intersections are classified for every n≥2; the stabilizer-fixed terminal objects give an equivariant nerve equivalence; explicit symmetric simplex homotopies yield K(2,n²) equivariantly. Chain orientation identifies the integral sign-twisted augmentation module, group-element fixed-coset counts yield the three-case character, and its orbit graph is a star. Exhaustive exact checks confirm n=2,...,7; checks are not the infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The broad 2023 theorem implies the old wedge rank but does not assert or imply from that homotopy type alone the integral left-action representation. The exact graph data motivate, but do not state, the equivariant refinement.
